content.value: A jet of water moving at 25 m/s impinges on a symmetrical curved vane where the jet strikes tangentially and is deflected through $1 3 0 ^ { \circ }$ . If the vane is moving at $5 \mathrm { m } / \mathrm { s } ,$ find the angle of the jet so that there is no shock at the inlet. Also, determine the absolute velocity of the exit in magnitude and direction.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
